description.value:
Your body has relearned how to grow back what it loses.

Gift — Reattach severed digits by holding them in place for 10 minutes; regrow lost ones over a week. Persistent bleed on you is easier to stop (DC 10 instead of 15). Tithe — Your flesh wants to grow: Blooms you suffer are one step worse.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Persistent bleed on you is easier to stop (DC 10 instead of 15)" has no confirmed rule-element hook: unlike the dying condition's recovery DC (system.attributes.dying.recoveryDC, adjustable via ActiveEffectLike -- real precedent: pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment-effects/effect-resurrection-tea.json), a persistent condition's own flat-check DC is tracked per-instance on the condition, not as a global actor attribute, and no rule element adjusting it was found.
